name: Bellhouse Medical Equipment Services Special Needs
description: Bell House Medical, also known as Master Grab Bar, is a home safety and medical equipment business on Coastal Highway in Lewes, Delaware, serving customers across Delaware and Maryland since 1986. It installs stairlifts, grab bars, railings, vertical platform lifts, vehicle scooter lifts, porch lifts and wheelchair ramps, and carries out home modifications such as doorway widening and tub-to-shower conversions so older adults can remain at home. Its retail store sells and rents equipment including scooters, lift chairs, rollators, canes, orthopedic supports, ortho boots and compression stockings.
